title: Open method
idea: Open method: A readable method and executable or inspectable example sit together, followed by precise limitations.
audience: People who need to inspect method within a marketing surface.
worksWellWhen: Visitors are technical and need reproducible behavior.
avoidWhen: A code-like panel would be decorative or unsafe to run.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic command layout through its inspect method priority and explicit commitment contract: Do not execute copied commands automatically; explain prerequisites and effects.
navigation: Open method keeps the current inspect method context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: A readable method and executable or inspectable example sit together, followed by precise limitations.
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to inspect method; visitors are technical and need reproducible behavior.
composition.priority: Do not execute copied commands automatically; explain prerequisites and effects.

imagery.role: Support the actual inspect method context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Let code scroll within its own labelled region while instructions reflow.
Use a legible phone reading order; media never blocks the primary proposition.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the open method structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no inspect method content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Do not execute copied commands automatically; explain prerequisites and effects.
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized inspect method content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Do not execute copied commands automatically; explain prerequisites and effects.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active inspect method context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure initial transfer, layout stability and real image decode cost at the chosen device.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
